name: @ev-maps/monorepo
description: EV Maps - Astro + Web Components + Cloudflare

scripts.dev: concurrently --names worker,astro --prefix-colors yellow,cyan --kill-others-on-fail "bun run --cwd packages/worker dev" "bun run --cwd packages/app dev"
scripts.lint: bun run --cwd packages/app lint && bun run --cwd packages/app lint:css && bun run --cwd packages/worker lint && bun run --cwd packages/tiles lint && bun run --cwd packages/ui lint && bun run --cwd packages/ui lint:css && bun run --cwd packages/e2e lint && bun run --cwd packages/ai-action-configs lint && bun run lint:md
